# Amazon Seller Central

Stores and marketplaces · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Amazon publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Amazon's official Selling Partner agentic toolkit: 12 skills on Amazon's hosted connector (sellingpartner-ai.amazon.com/mcp), with every write drafted for approval. The three finance and inventory skills are indexed (month-end close, seller analytics, stockout prevention); the rest cover listings, FBA inbound, user invites and support cases.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://sellingpartner-ai.amazon.com/mcp** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Amazon Seller Central account. Amazon's Selling Partner connector, signed in through Seller Central; the toolkit's skills run on it.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Amazon

- **[Amazon month-end close](../../skills/amz-finance-month-end-closer/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Amazon Selling Partner connector (Seller Central OAuth) · [source](https://github.com/amzn/selling-partner-agentic-toolkit/tree/main/skills/finance-month-end-closer)
  Amazon's own skill for closing a seller's Amazon month: pulls the month's activity, overlapping settlements, carried balances and payout statuses, reconciles them, checks payouts against bank deposits the seller pastes in, and writes an accountant-ready summary.
- **[Amazon seller analytics](../../skills/amz-seller-analytics/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Amazon Selling Partner connector (Seller Central OAuth) · [source](https://github.com/amzn/selling-partner-agentic-toolkit/tree/main/skills/seller-analytics)
  Amazon's own skill for a seller's sales, traffic and inventory-health questions, answered from the Selling Partner connector's analytics tools in plain language.
- **[Amazon stockout prevention](../../skills/amz-stockout-prevention/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Amazon Selling Partner connector (Seller Central OAuth) · [source](https://github.com/amzn/selling-partner-agentic-toolkit/tree/main/skills/stockout-prevention)
  Amazon's own skill for FBA inventory health: days of cover from sales velocity, inbound-shipment gaps and restocking, with any price change drafted for the seller to approve.
